bounds: A run that cannot find a rootless daemon SKIPS, and a SKIP is never a pass; --require-docker turns it into exit 3.
The live/browser arms are model-driven and depend on the operator's credential; a credential-free run cannot see a path that depends on an EMPTY model catalog.
Declared bounds (`userSurface.bound.<id>`) are composed-but-not-individually-proven rows, not passes.
The driver's own evidence lands under evidence/docker/<slug>/<stamp>/ per its contract; this lane copies the verdicts and metadata into this release directory.
requiredProofsStatement: INSTALL, MOUNT (rows activating, tools registering, TUI present, agentPreset=mpd), the userSurface arm, and both stamps 0.2.2-rc.5 / 0.20.2 are TRUE in all three runs; the overall FAIL comes from run 2's six TUI team-fixture rows, not from the version, install or mount proof.

findings.symptom: tui.teamFixtureBound NULL (session=none materialized=false attempts=4; store before=3 after=3) and five dependent scene rows plus tui.laneExit FALSE; run exits 1
findings.cause: the TUI team fixture was never bound to a live session; the product drew its correct empty state and a live turn later used session e078be04, so the materializer did not observe the session store change
findings.direction: drive /mpd board only after the chat session is registered / wait on the session store's own signal, then re-run the oneclick live arm; root cause not settled by this lane

findings.symptom: run 1 built HEAD e3f36a99 + 44 dirty paths before the wave commit; runs 2-3 built commit 2cfa9430
findings.cause: the captain committed the wave and two evidence-only commits while run 1 was in flight; the only substantive delta is VENDOR_LOCK.json (vendor re-pin, after run 1's build freeze), which is packed but not among the 32 hashed installed files
findings.direction: re-run the source --live arm on the final commit if the release record must cite a single artifact

findings.symptom: tui.hostInstall records version=$TUI_VERSION (the requested exact pin), not an observed installed version
findings.cause: the lane installs @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui@0.20.2 exactly and echoes the pin; the harness stamp is measured
findings.direction: read the installed profile package.json or dsh-tui --version back into the stamp

reproducibility of the oneclick fixture failure: exactly one run per required command, nothing retried
the 35 userSurface.row.* NULLs per run: each excused by a TRUE userSurface.bound.<id> marker (35/35)
